$description: Industries and their rules. A family declares one or more industries in settings.industry. The build applies the strictest value across the engine, the owner and every declared industry, and fails if the family breaks a checkable rule. Guidelines are not machine checked; they are written to <owner>/docs/industry-rules.md and into dist/tokens for agents and reviewers. Rules can only make things stricter than the engine.

checkable-rules.contrast-text-min: Minimum contrast for every text pair, muted text included (4.5 is WCAG AA, 7 is AAA)
checkable-rules.contrast-ui-min: Minimum contrast for control boundaries, focus rings and meaningful icons
checkable-rules.font-size-min: Smallest text size allowed (the caption step of the type scale)
checkable-rules.dynamic-color: Android wallpaper color policies the family may use

health.name: Health and care
guidelines: Aim for WCAG 2.2 AAA wherever it is achievable, not only for contrast.
Status (normal, attention, critical) is always shown with an icon and words, never color alone, and status colors are never replaced by wallpaper colors.
Clinical values always carry their unit and reference range.
Destructive and irreversible actions (deleting records, sending prescriptions) require explicit confirmation that names what will happen.
Plan for offline and poor connectivity: show sync state and never lose input.
Plain language at about an 8th grade reading level for patient facing text.

finance.name: Finance and money
guidelines: Amounts use tabular figures and always show the currency.
Positive and negative values differ by sign and words, not color alone.
Money movement needs a review step and a clear confirmation.
Sensitive values can be hidden with one tap.

education.name: Education and learning
guidelines: Progress is visible and saved automatically.
Feedback on answers is immediate, specific and never shaming.
Support learners using screen readers and keyboards end to end.

children.name: Children and families
guidelines: Any screen a child can reach has no ads, no dark patterns and no purchases without a parent gate.
Collect no personal data from children beyond what the service strictly needs; follow LGPD and COPPA rules for minors.
Use icons together with words; do not rely on reading alone.
Communication with parents or guardians states schedules, safety and contacts plainly.

sports-fitness.name: Sports and fitness
guidelines: Schedules, prices and locations are always one tap away and set in clear, large numerals.
Screens used outdoors or mid workout need high contrast and big targets.
Never promise guaranteed results; describe training, not outcomes.
Health related data (weight, heart rate, injuries) follows the health guidelines.

information-science.name: Information science and knowledge tools
guidelines: Long reading is set for comfort: reading face, generous line height, 60 to 75 characters per line.
Identifiers and classification codes use a monospaced face so they line up.
Every item shows where it is filed; nothing is lost without a trace (undo, trash, history).
The user's data can always be exported in an open format.

commerce.name: Commerce and retail
guidelines: Total price, fees and delivery time are visible before checkout.
No pre checked add ons and no countdown pressure that is not real.
Product images have text alternatives.

arts-culture.name: Arts, crafts and culture
guidelines: The work is the hero: neutral interface around images, no tinted overlays on artwork.
Credit the artist and give alt text for every work.
Images load progressively and stay sharp on large screens.

public-service.name: Government and public services
guidelines: Meet WCAG 2.2 AA at minimum and the local legal standard (in Brazil, eMAG).
Plain language, one task per page.
Every form explains what is needed before it starts.
